title: Har Ped Par Latakti Gudiyan! 😱 Mexico Ka Bhootiya Taapu #shorts
description:
Ek taapu… jahan har ped par latki hain saikdon daraavni gudiyan! 😱
Mexico City ki nehron ke beech 'Isla de las Muñecas', aur iske peechhe ek dukh bhari kahani.

Dukh ki kahani ya bhooton ka taapu? 👇 Comment mein batao!

📜 Facts: Isla de las Muñecas (Island of the Dolls) Mexico City ke Xochimilco nehron mein hai. Iske dekhbhaal karne wale Don Julián Santana Barrera yahan akele rehte the aur lagbhag 50 saal tak saikdon gudiyan pedon par latkaate rahe. Kehte hain unhe paani mein doobi ek bachchi mili thi, aur phir ek tairti gudiya, jise unhone uski aatma ke liye latka diya. 2001 mein unki maut hui; bataya jaata hai ki wo usi jagah nehar mein doobe jahan unhone bachchi dekhne ki baat kahi thi. Unke rishtedaar kehte hain ki wo bachchi shayad kabhi thi hi nahi.
